kiselev-bios-a4af458-atreset-src

Corresponding source for two 32 KiB boot ROMs that the unemupc98 emulator
project builds from Sergey Kiselev's 8088_bios, Xi8088 configuration
(MACHINE_XI8088):

  bios-xi8088.bin          unmodified upstream source
    SHA-256 1ad458acb1f22dee6b3d9b6bd95e83218a7ddc5389fa2b2c67a4001e689c81a8
  bios-xi8088-atreset.bin  upstream source with at-reset.patch applied
    SHA-256 61589573c9809273198b137d9419c87242b0a5f63c2ad834a9565950c3d6becc

Contents

  8088_bios/      https://github.com/skiselev/8088_bios at commit
                  a4af458a72bc33c4be066b33bd76e8af2b24111c (BIOS version
                  1.0.2), with at-reset.patch applied. Upstream's prebuilt
                  images, binaries/ and xtide_r625/, are left out: they are
                  build outputs, not source, neither ROM above contains them,
                  and xtide_r625/ holds XTIDE Universal BIOS r625 binaries
                  whose source is not part of this archive. Upstream's
                  flash-image targets that combine the BIOS with those
                  binaries (the *-xtide*.rom images in src/Makefile and
                  CMakeLists.txt) therefore do not build from this archive.
  at-reset.patch  the only change to upstream source, made by the unemupc98
                  project on 2026-11-11: INT 13h function 00h (reset)
                  accepts any drive number in DL, as the IBM PC AT BIOS does,
                  so a fixed-disk option ROM can reset the diskette
                  controller through the system BIOS.
  NOTICE          this file.

Licence

  GPL-3.0-or-later. Copyright (C) 2010 - 2026 Sergey Kiselev; see the file
  headers and 8088_bios/LICENSE.txt. at-reset.patch modifies that source and
  is licensed under the same terms.

Rebuild

  With NASM (measured with NASM 3.01), from the 8088_bios directory:

    nasm -isrc/ -DMACHINE_XI8088 -O9 -f bin -w-all -o bios-xi8088-atreset.bin src/bios.asm
    patch -R -p1 < ../at-reset.patch
    nasm -isrc/ -DMACHINE_XI8088 -O9 -f bin -w-all -o bios-xi8088.bin src/bios.asm

  The first command builds the patched ROM, the patch reversal restores the
  upstream source, and the second command builds the original ROM. Both
  results must match the SHA-256 values above.
